annotations.title: Recent SEC filings of a company

description: Returns a company's recent SEC filings, classified (earnings, 8-K items, notes and loans, share offerings, prospectuses…), each with its acceptance time, accession number and sec.gov link; a financing filing carries what it says — amount, coupon, maturity, status, the sentence it comes from. Insider filings (Forms 3, 4, 5 and 144) are left out unless asked for: their purchases and sales are summed over 90 days in `insiderFlow90d`, with the filer's role, not the person's name. Filings are dated by acceptance time, not filing date. Use it when the user asks what a company has filed, announced, borrowed or raised recently.

insiders.description: Include insider filings (Forms 3, 4, 5 and 144), left out by default.

symbol.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, AMD, ASML, 'nvidia', 'taiwan semiconductor'. Case-insensitive.
